name: Back pressure valve
function: A check valve threaded into the tubing hanger that holds pressure from below so the tree can be removed or installed, while still allowing fluid to be pumped down the tubing from above.

tabs.overview: Set and retrieved through the tree with a lubricator and a running tool. It is the barrier that lets the frac stack come off and the production tree go on without killing the well when tubing is in place. The two-way check valve is used instead when the tree above must be pressure tested.
tabs.engineering: API 6A; profile type must match the hanger; rated to the tubing head working pressure.
tabs.safety: Verify the BPV is set and holding before breaking the tree connection; a BPV that is not fully threaded can be blown out when the tree is removed.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.
